Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.compat

Class SpellbooksCompat

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.compat.SpellbooksCompat
public final class SpellbooksCompat extends Object
Spellbooks' zombie and skeleton summons use GeckoLib while rising, then a private vanilla renderer. Both paths use vanilla part-local eye coordinates so their placement and picker drafts agree.

  • Method Details

    • applyPartSpace

      public static void applyPartSpace(com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack pose, float pivotX, float pivotY, float pivotZ)
      GeckoLib's bone callback is in model coordinates after translating away from the pivot. Move back to that pivot and turn its X/Y axes into the vanilla part frame used by the nested renderer.

    • isHybridRenderer

      public static boolean isHybridRenderer(String rendererClass)
      Whether this renderer switches between a GeckoLib model and a private vanilla renderer.

    • vanillaRenderer

      @Nullable public static net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.LivingEntityRenderer<?,?> vanillaRenderer(net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.EntityRenderer<?> renderer)
      The normal renderer behind a hybrid summon, or null for an unrelated or unavailable integration. Spellbooks exposes no accessor for this package-private field, so reflection is limited to its two known renderer classes and failures leave the other renderers available.
